title: CORE-7013 · FAQ banner image low-resolution / pixelated
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7013](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7013/rf-shared-faq-banner-image-low-resolution-pixelated) · state `In Progress` · priority P4

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

**Pages (SHARED — all 23 FAQ topic pages):**
`/faqs/after-company-formation/`, `/faqs/annual-accounts/`, `/faqs/basics/`, `/faqs/company-meetings-and-resolutions/`, `/faqs/company-names/`, `/faqs/company-records-and-registers/`, `/faqs/company-secretary/`, `/faqs/confirmation-statement/`, `/faqs/corporation-tax/`, `/faqs/directors/`, `/faqs/directors-service-address/`, `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/`, `/faqs/limited-by-shares/`, `/faqs/limited-liability-partnerships/`, `/faqs/paye-and-payroll/`, `/faqs/paying-yourself-through-limited-company/`, `/faqs/pscs/`, `/faqs/registered-office/`, `/faqs/sail-address/`, `/faqs/self-assessment/`, `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders/`, `/faqs/the-formation-process/`, `/faqs/vat/`
*(The* `/faqs/` *hub uses a different template — no banner — and is not affected.)*

**Component:** Banner image (top of page)
**Breakpoints:** All (most visible on desktop, where the banner renders largest)

## Issue

The clone’s banner is served from a **much smaller master image than live** and is then upscaled to fill the 1170px-wide slot, so it renders **blurry / pixelated**. The crop and scale themselves match live (object-fit `cover`, same box, same object-position) — the difference is purely **resolution**. This low resolution is also what makes the banner look slightly “soft / zoomed-out” next to live.

## Expected (Live) vs Actual (Clone)

| Page | Live master | Clone master | Displayed at |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| shares-and-shareholders | 800×170 (srcset PNG to 1170w) | **356×76** | 1170×250 |
| annual-accounts | 800×170 | **585×125** | 964×206 (@1024) |
| company-names | 800×170 | **585×125** | 964×206 (@1024) |
| directors | 800×170 | **585×125** | 964×206 (@1024) |

Clone masters are below display size, so the browser upscales (shares-and-shareholders worst, ~3.3×).

## Definition of Done

* Banner served at a resolution **≥ its displayed size** (≥1170px wide equivalent, retina ideally 2×) so it renders crisp at all breakpoints — no upscaling of a sub-display-size master.
* Applies to the banner on every FAQ topic page listed above.

## Note

This ticket also resolves the “banner looks slightly zoomed-out” observation — that impression is the low-res softness, not an actual scale/crop change.

## Evidence

Banner crop, Live (crisp) vs Clone (blurry from upscaling). Clearest at the larger sizes.

**Mobile @360**

| -- | -- |

---
### Planning note
Likely a CMS/media fix (masters uploaded below display size) rather than a code change — establish which before editing code. Also resolves the separate "banner looks slightly zoomed-out" observation, which the ticket attributes to low-res softness, not an actual scale/crop change.

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
acceptanceCriteria: Banner served at a resolution ≥ its displayed size (≥1170px wide equivalent, retina 2× ideally) so it renders crisp at all breakpoints — no upscaling of a sub-display-size master.
Applies to the banner on all 23 FAQ topic pages listed in the ticket (the `/faqs/` hub uses a different template — no banner — and must not change).
